يتعاطيا (form VI)
# يَتَعَاطَيَا (yataʕāṭayā) /ja.ta.ʕaː.tˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# يُتَعَاطَيَا (yutaʕāṭayā) /ju.ta.ʕaː.tˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
